notes.title: Announcement of a Second Release Delay for “Darugarami Haigorei”
notes.notes:
We had planned to release “Darugarami Haigorei” in September, but due to unexpected development issues we must postpone the release once again, now targeting October.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the game for the inconvenience and concern caused by these repeated delays.

Thank you very much for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Announcement of the Postponement of the Release of “Darugarami Haigorei”
notes.notes:
I had planned to release Darugarami Haigorei in August, but as a solo developer, I’ve run into some delays in development. As a result, I’m truly sorry to say that the release date will be postponed to September.

I deeply apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the game for the inconvenience and worry this may cause.

Thank you so much for your understanding and patience.
